name: prompt-few-shot
description: Use when the user asks about few-shot or one-shot prompts, writing few-shot examples for a classification prompt, in-context examples, dynamic example selection or a model that ignores the output format. Produces a delimited example block, selection strategy and a zero-shot vs k-shot eval. Not for reasoning prompts (use prompt-chain-of-thought) or fine-tuning (use llm-finetuning).
